statement.text:
Let G be a sharply doubly transitive permutation group on a set Ω (see
Archive 11.52 for a definition).
   (a) Does G possess a regular normal subgroup if a point stabilizer is locally finite?
  (b) Does G possess a regular normal subgroup if a point stabilizer has an abelian
subgroup of finite index?
    Comments of 2022: an affirmative answer to part (b) is obtained in permutation
characteristic 0 (F. O. Wagner, Preprint, 2022, https://hal.archives-ouvertes.
fr/hal-03590818).                                                       V. D. Mazurov
